transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because I’m so afraid of rats that it’s starting to stop me from doing parts of my cleaning job. Even thinking I might see one—in a trash room or an old part of a building—gets overwhelming, even though I know it may not actually be dangerous.
Outside of rats, do you find yourself constantly worrying about other everyday situations or problems in your life?
Not really. It’s mostly the rats. I don’t find myself worrying all the time about lots of other everyday things.
How long has this fear of rats been going on?
About two years now. It started after I moved into this older apartment building where people were always talking about rats.
